search_rezero_season_4_dashed.json.request: GET /anime?filter[text]=Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4&page[size]=20&page[number]=1&fields[anime]=canonicalTitle,titles,abbreviatedTitles,slug,synopsis,startDate,endDate,episodeCount,averageRating,subtype,status,posterImage,coverImage,ageRating,popularityRank
search_rezero_season_4_dashed.json.notes: Kitsu reads a '-' that no letter or digit precedes as an exclusion (the client sends as a gap every '-' that no ASCII letter or digit precedes): this, the provider's Re:ZERO Season 4 title sent as given, answers Zoids Genesis (anime/646) alone.
